title: Add gomock unit tests for the betterado_task_group resource
essence: The task group resource (a net-new fork addition) previously had zero unit test coverage. Five gomock-based unit tests now verify Create, Read, Update, Delete, and expand/flatten round-trip behaviour, closing the highest-value offline test gap in the provider.
